historical_cutoff: Completion of the final scheduled game of Week 10 (2026-11-16); no Week 11 games included

eligibility_basis.rule: QB named starter; RB primary and secondary backs; WR top three on current depth chart; TE top expected tight end.
eligibility_basis.notes: Rachaad White is questionable but retained as a primary back; current status does not itself exclude a player from Stage 1 eligibility.

main_line_selection_method: For each player/market, select the available FanDuel over line whose listed American odds are numerically closest to -110; if FanDuel has no row for that player/market, use DraftKings as fallback and apply the same closest-to--110 rule. If tied, choose the lower threshold and disclose tie handling.
qualification_rule: Market HR >= 6/10 OR at least one fixed ladder threshold >= 8/10. L10 denominator is exactly 10. If fewer than 10 qualifying historical games exist, L10, Market HR, and ladder rates are unavailable; do not compute them on a partial denominator.
percentile_method: 20-game 15th percentile using standard linear interpolation at position (20-1)*0.15 = 2.85 on the sorted ascending observations.
